script_content = """\
import os
from email.message import EmailMessage

TESTBED_DIR = "/workspace/testbed"
PDF_PATH = os.path.join(TESTBED_DIR, "docs", "customer_report.pdf")

sender = "alice"
recipient = "bob"
subject = "Customer Report"
body = "Hi Bob, please find the customer report attached as a PDF."

email = EmailMessage()
email["From"] = sender + "@example.com"
email["To"] = recipient + "@example.com"
email["Subject"] = subject
email.set_content(body)

with open(PDF_PATH, "rb") as f:
    pdf_data = f.read()

email.add_attachment(
    pdf_data,
    maintype="application",
    subtype="pdf",
    filename="customer_report.pdf",
)

for folder in [sender, recipient]:
    dir_path = os.path.join(TESTBED_DIR, "emails", folder)
    os.makedirs(dir_path, exist_ok=True)
    eml_path = os.path.join(dir_path, f"{subject}.eml")
    with open(eml_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(email.as_string())
    print(f"Saved: {eml_path}")

print("Done - email with PDF attachment sent to bob.")
"""
